{{SameName|Clown|'''Nightmare Carnival''' • [[Clown (Lunar Overture)|Lunar Overture]] • [[Clown|Pizza Party]] • [[Clown (Sticker)|Sticker]]}} {{EventSandboxOnly|date = 9th of November 2019|event = [[Halloween 2019 Event]]}} {{For|a [[Jester]] skin of the same name}} {{Zombie |title1 = Clown |image1 = C10wn.png |mode_appearance = [[Sandbox Mode|Sandbox]] via [[Logbooks]] ---- Originally:
[[Halloween 2019 Event|Halloween 2019]] |first_wave_appearance = 15 (Originaly) |base_hp = [[File:HealthIcon.png|20px|Health]]600 |speed = [[File:SpeedIcon.png|20px|Speed]]Fast (6) |spawned_by = [[Jack O' Bot]] |hidden = No |fly = No |ghost = No |lead = No |immunity = None }}{{QuoteContainer| {{QuoteBox|Hope you're not afraid of clowns...|Beginning of Wave 15 ([[Nightmare Carnival]])}} }} __TOC__ ==Description== The '''Clown''' was an [[Enemies|enemy]] that appeared exclusively in [[Nightmare Carnival]] as part of the [[Halloween 2019 Event]] and was the fastest enemy in the event. It can currently be spawned in [[Sandbox Mode|Sandbox]] mode. It was very dangerous due to its very high health and fast speed. The '''Clown''' could be spawned by [[Jack O' Bot]]. ==Appearance== {{Tabber |Current |The '''Clown''' wars a stereotypical carnival clown outfit. It has a yellow torso, red legs, white sleeves and green skin. Its torso has three red buttons. It wearsa red wig, has a red nose, and wears a blue and white neck ruff. |Version 1 |The first version of the '''Clown''' is similar to the second version, except it had a clown face. }} ==Strategy== As this enemy only appears through [[Sandbox Mode|Sandbox]] mode, no strategy section is made for its current version. Instead, a strategy section for the one that appeared without [[Sandbox Mode|Sandbox]] mode in [[Nightmare Carnival]] is listed instead. *The [[Pyromancer]] and [[Freezer]] are strongly recommended to slow the '''Clowns''' down. *The '''Clown''' always spawn in groups, so splash damage towers like the [[Rocketeer]] will fare well against these [[enemies]]. **Keep in mind that the slow firerate means that some '''Clowns''' may get out of range. In that case, other towers will be needed. *The [[Minigunner]], [[Ranger|Outlaw]] and [[Turret]] are fairly useful against '''Clowns''' due to their high DPS. ==Gallery== {{Gallery| {{GalleryHeader|Previous Variants}} Clown.png|First version (18 October 2019 – 9 November 2019) {{GalleryHeader|Corpse Variants}} CorpseLegacyClown.png|Second [[Corpse (Enemy)|Corpse]] variant, current version (12 March 2025 – Present) {{GalleryHeader|Miscellaneous}} LegacyClownIconIG.png|'''Clown''' on its [[Index]] icon. }} ==Trivia== *In real life, clowns were first pitched as entertainers in carnivals, but later gained a reputation of being scary due to their appearance. ==Update History== *'''18 October 2019''' - [[Release v1.1|Release v1.1.0]] **'''Clown''' added. *'''9 November 2019''' - [[Release v1.2|Release v1.2.0]] **'''Clown''' removed. *'''22 January 2025''' - [[v1.50.0]] **'''Clown''' can now be summoned in [[Sandbox Mode|Sandbox]] mode, only when the player has the [[Clown]]'s [[Logbooks|Logbook]] from [[Pizza Party]]. **Due to changes made with updates, its face has been removed. *'''12 February 2025''' - [[v1.53.0]] **No longer copies the statistics of the modern version in [[Sandbox Mode|Sandbox]] mode. {{NightmareCarnival|[[Reaper (Nightmare Carnival)|Reaper]] & [[Witch (Nightmare Carnival)|Witch]]|Wave 12|Clown|Wave 15|[[Frankenstein (Nightmare Carnival)|Frankenstein]]|Wave 16}} {{ZombieNavBox}} {{DISPLAYTITLE:Clown}} [[Category:Sandbox Only]]
